title: Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain
abstract: arXiv:2610.01096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. translated_title: 数据集身份，而非新颖性：OOD检测增益被夸大的来源
translated_abstract: 事后式分布外检测器读取已训练分类器的激活值并返回一个分数。它在分布内数据上拟合该分数，而评估它的基准测试则额外提供一份OOD数据用于拟合本身。一些检测器在其上调整一个常数；另一些则在特征空间中拟合一个方向，或训练一个灵活的组合器，并将其达到的数值报告为仍然可获得的增益。每一次这样的拟合都在同一OOD数据集的留出样本上进行验证。这种检查排除了对单张图像的记忆，却无法察觉那些学到的其实是“正在面对的是哪个数据集”的拟合——一个识别特定OOD数据集而非真正新颖性的方向可以完美通过该验证。而从业者实际部署的检测器所遇到的OOD数据，来自无人对其拟合过的来源，因此这一差异决定了所报告数值的真正价值。我们通过留出整个OOD数据集而非（摘要在此截断）……
tldr: 事后式OOD检测器在评估时可能学到的是特定OOD数据集的身份而非真正的新颖性识别能力，导致报告的检测增益被夸大，必须用全新来源的OOD数据才能揭示真实性能。
